Undead · SM +0 Wraith (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5, SRD 5.1)

A hooded shape of moving darkness with nothing inside the hood, drifting a little above the floor. Weapons find nothing to bite on. Its touch drains the life out of a body, and what it kills tends to get up and drift after it.
